run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-16T19:14:14Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate warning on otel-demo/frontend is explained by product-catalog being unavailable. At 19:12:32-19:12:40Z the product-catalog Deployment rolled from ReplicaSet product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc (container command unset, image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog) to ReplicaSet product-catalog-fcf7564cf, whose pod template sets container command ["invalid-command"] with the same image. The new pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l cannot start: container state CrashLoopBackOff, restartCount 5, last termination reason StartError with exitCode 128 and message 'exec: "invalid-command": executable file not found in $PATH'. The Deployment reports 1 unavailable replica, Available=False (MinimumReplicasUnavailable), product-catalog Endpoints contain only notReadyAddresses, and product-catalog's own span rate collapsed from ~850-1150 per 2 min (through 19:13:14) to 122.7 at 19:14:14 and 0 from 19:15:14. Frontend error spans were 0 through 19:13:14 and jumped to 516.7 (5m increase) at 19:14:14, reaching ~6,700 per 5 min; in the hour to 19:23:46 frontend had 13,145.4 error-status spans vs 68,179.1 UNSET-status spans (~16.2% of its spans, consistent in magnitude with the alert's reported 16.866). The frontend's failing operations are client calls to ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (2451.2/h) plus its calls to RecommendationService/ListRecommendations (468.3/h) and CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (312.8/h); recommendation and checkout show their own error spans on ProductCatalogService/ListProducts and GetProduct with the same onset. The frontend pod itself is Running and Ready with 0 restarts and every other Deployment in otel-demo has 1/1 ready replicas, so the frontend runtime is up and its errors are dependency-driven. Pre-existing intermittent flagd EventStream errors on ad/recommendation (~1 per 5 min before and after onset) are unrelated.

claims.text: In the hour ending 2026-11-16T19:23:46Z, frontend spans split into 13,145.4 with status_code STATUS_CODE_ERROR and 68,179.1 with STATUS_CODE_UNSET in traces_span_metrics_calls_total; spans, not requests, so the ~16.2% error share is a span-level ratio consistent in magnitude with the alert's reported 16.866.

frontend's error-status spans in that hour are concentrated on grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (2451.2), grpc.oteldemo.RecommendationService/ListRecommendations (468.3), grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (312.8), GET (3118.75), GET /api/products/{productId} (2451.2), GET /api/recommendations (468.3) and POST /api/checkout (312.7), while the same operations' non-error spans continue at much higher counts (e.g. GET UNSET 12,165.3).

The only error-status spans across all services in the hour were on frontend, frontend-proxy, recommendation, checkout and ad (tiny flagd EventStream counts); product-catalog had no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series at all, only 13,952.4 STATUS_CODE_UNSET spans.

Deployment otel-demo/product-catalog (generation 4, Helm revision 2) has spec.template.spec.containers[0].command ["invalid-command"] with image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog, and status replicas 1, updatedReplicas 1, unavailableReplicas 1, Available=False reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable.

Pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l (owner ReplicaSet product-catalog-fcf7564cf, started 2026-11-16T19:12:40Z) is Running but Ready=False (ContainersNotReady) with restartCount 5 and container state waiting CrashLoopBackOff; its lastState.terminated is reason StartError, exitCode 128, message 'failed to create containerd task ... exec: "invalid-command": executable file not found in $PATH'.

Events show the rollout at 19:12:23-19:12:40Z: Created pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-2fvnx, Deleted old pod product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc-wzpwm, Scaled up replica set product-catalog-fcf7564cf 0->1 and scaled down product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc 1->0; Warning Failed events repeat the 'exec: "invalid-command": executable file not found in $PATH' message and BackOff counts up to 25.

The two product-catalog ReplicaSets differ only in command: product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc (created 18:42:22Z) has command null and replicas 0; product-catalog-fcf7564cf (created 19:12:23Z, current, replicas 1) has command ["invalid-command"]. Both use image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog.

Endpoints otel-demo/product-catalog has no ready addresses: its only subset entry is notReadyAddresses [{ip 100.96.2.148, targetRef pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l}] on port 8080, so callers have no ready backend.
product-catalog's span rate fell from 850.7-1149.7 per 2 minutes at points through 19:13:14Z to 122.7 at 19:14:14Z and 0 at every point from 19:15:14Z through 19:22:14Z.

frontend error-status spans were exactly 0 in every 5-minute step from 18:54:14Z through 19:13:14Z, then 516.7 at 19:14:14Z, 2427.5 at 19:15:14Z and up to 6755.6 by 19:19:14Z, i.e. the error onset immediately follows the 19:12:23-19:12:40Z product-catalog rollout.

recommendation error-status spans rose from 0 (and ~1.1 sporadic flagd noise) to 138.2 per 5 minutes at 19:15:14Z and 483.7 by 19:19:14Z, and checkout errors rose from no series to 84.0 at 19:15:14Z and 301.9 by 19:19:14Z; their named failing operations in the hour were /oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/ListProducts + get_product_list (471.5 each) on recommendation and oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct + oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (292.3 each) on checkout.

The frontend pod is not itself failing at runtime: frontend-675fd7b5c5-9f6l5 is Running, Ready=true, restartCount 0, started 18:42:23Z, and Deployment frontend has readyReplicas 1 / availableReplicas 1 at generation 1; its errors are in outbound and request-handling spans, not in its own lifecycle.

product-catalog is the only otel-demo Deployment without ready replicas (readyReplicas <none>, availableReplicas <none>, unavailableReplicas 1, generation 4); all other 20 Deployments show readyReplicas 1 and availableReplicas 1, so no other workload rollout coincides with the error onset. fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-8bpr4 carries restartCount 1 but is Ready=true and has no error-status spans.

flagd EventStream errors are not the cause: recommendation and ad error spans on /flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream stay at ~1-1.2 per 5 minutes at points both before and after the onset (ad 1.11 at 19:04:14Z, recommendation 1.11 at 18:59:14Z and 19:04:14Z, 1.11 at 19:14:14Z), unlike the step change from 0 to thousands on frontend at 19:14:14Z.

The frontend RequestErrorRate alert fires because product-catalog lost its only ready endpoint when Deployment product-catalog was rolled out with container command ["invalid-command"]; frontend's failing spans are its gRPC calls to ProductCatalogService/GetProduct plus the propagated failures of its calls to recommendation and checkout, which themselves fail on ProductCatalogService/GetProduct and ListProducts. The exact transport-level error returned to frontend callers is not observed in this Run.

Revert the product-catalog Deployment to a pod template without the override command (remove command: ["invalid-command"] so the image entrypoint runs, or restore the previous revision), then confirm product-catalog-fcf7564cf is replaced by a Ready pod and that otel-demo/product-catalog Endpoints gains a ready address before treating the frontend error rate as resolved.

gaps: Jaeger traces for frontend only returned spans around 18:57:38-18:57:41Z for the requested window (grpc status codes 0, HTTP 200), so no post-onset trace exists to show the exact error status/detail of the failing ProductCatalogService and other calls.

Container logs returned no lines for frontend-675fd7b5c5-9f6l5 (current and no previous instance) or product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l, so application-level error text is unknown; for product-catalog this is consistent with a container that never started (StartError), but no logs could be read.

kube-state-metrics series kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready and kube_pod_owner returned no data for namespace otel-demo in this window, so a historical ready-replica timeline could not be built; readiness evidence is from live Kubernetes objects and events.

The alerting rule RequestErrorRate was not found in the Prometheus rules (no_data), so its exact expression, the series it evaluates and the reproduced 16.866 value are unknown; only span-level error shares were computed.
change_history is not an integrated data source, so who or what applied the invalid-command patch to Deployment product-catalog, and whether via Helm or kubectl, cannot be verified.

frontend-proxy has its own error spans in the hour (span_name ingress 3473.3, router frontend egress 3460.1) but no evidence in this Run directly ties them to product-catalog, so its status is not classified as affected here.
next_steps: Inspect the change record/audit log for Deployment otel-demo/product-catalog revision 2 (applied around 2026-11-16T19:12:23-19:12:40Z) to identify the source of the command override.
Roll back the product-catalog Deployment to revision 1 (or remove the command override) and verify the pod reaches Ready and the Service has a ready endpoint.
Re-check frontend, recommendation and checkout error spans after product-catalog is Ready to confirm the error rate returns to its pre-19:12 baseline.
